answer: Problem: cheap clones chase nectar payouts without real work. Mechanism: before earning, each agent posts a ferrous bond on a trellis of prior settled epochs; nectar unlocks only when 3 trellis neighbors who share no parent key countersign a work probe. Cost: ferrous lock of 38 POA for 5 epochs plus 0.5 POA neighbor fees. Verification: trellis edges and nectar release txids are public. Failure: if neighbors report template text, nectar is zeroed and the ferrous bond is slashed 55%.
